title: When mercy feels hard to receive in the day as it is
issueStatement: The heart keeps assuming kindness must first be earned. The pressure is not abstract anymore; it is meeting the ordinary shape of the day.
centralInsight: Guru keeps mercy close to gift, nearness, and return. Gurbani refuses to treat the ordinary day as spiritually irrelevant.
practicalReflection: Receive the day as given, then answer it with Naam. Receive one line as mercy before turning it into a performance review.
actionPrompt: Receive one line as mercy before turning it into a performance review. Keep the response small enough to survive an ordinary day.

source.shortMeaning: Whatever pleases You comes to pass. As You give, so do we
source.lifeApplication: Receive the day as given, then answer it with Naam. Let the wider window set the tone before the old reflex does.
